sample_input: EuRoC MAV MH_01_easy imu0/data.csv degraded with organiser degrade_imu.py as-is (seed 42, max_level 1.0)
entrypoint: python src/main.py <imu0/data.csv | folder | zip> [-o] estimated_trajectory.txt  (no input: auto-detects imu0/data.csv in the working directory)
language: Python 3 + numpy only; single CPU thread (BLAS pinned); offline

runtime.note: wall time incl. CSV parse and output write, warm run, numpy 2.x; 6-8 ms on repeated runs of this machine

memory.method: tracemalloc peak after interpreter + module imports (per FAQ), includes model weights; MB = 10^6 bytes

model.velocity_network: ensemble of 3 1-D CNNs (4 s window @ 50 Hz, ~120k params each), velocity-NLL training then integrated-displacement fine-tuning; float16 weights (0.73 MB)
model.rotor_drag: body-frame drag velocity on the thrust-perpendicular plane, 0.4 s blocks, rotor-vibration gate, Cauchy IRLS; gains fitted per CV fold
model.rest_updates: zero-velocity updates while parked with rotors off (steady |a|, low rotor vibration); drag channel off there

validation_heldout_11_euroc_sequences.protocol: 3-fold grouped cross-validation by sequence (no sequence scored by a model that saw it); SE(3) Umeyama ATE, verified identical to evo_ape

no_return_stress_test.setup: flights truncated at 65% (drone mid-air, up to 11 m from launch)

validation_tumvi_6_rooms.note: handheld/generic profile: workspace-bounded smoother, physics only (network and drag off); held-out-room CV ATE 0.626 m

college: Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology, Patiala (TIET)
